分享原卷｜第29題

完整原題

作答所需文章／材料

The Aliens Many years ago, there were some alien visitors to the planet Earth. Now the aliens are coming back, and they aren’t very friendly! Don’t see this movie by yourself if you get scared easily. The critics say, “The special effects were great. I was so scared!” “A wonderful science fiction film!” The Shy Boy Roxy is in love with his best friend, Rosa. But Rosa doesn’t know it because Roxy is shy, and doesn’t tell her. This movie is for fans of romance... and a happy ending! The critics say, “The movie was happy and sad. The ending was great.” “The story wasn’t very good, but the acting was great.” Robot Crazy In the city of Future, robots live with people. But one robot, Zax, turns strange and starts making a mess. Can the people stop Zax before it is too late? Laugh out loud with this robot! The critics say, “I laughed so much. The story was exciting.” “Even if you are not a fan of robot stories, you are sure to love this one.”

Which picture is right? (A) 原圖A：The Aliens（飛碟中的外星角色） (B) 原圖B：Robot Crazy（抱著地球、神情嚴肅的機器人） (C) 原圖C：Robot Crazy（開心活動的機器人） (D) 原圖D：The Shy Boy（機器人旁有愛心）

原卷作答：使用者原始紀錄：29@錯題A → C；原筆跡保留於下方原卷。
(C) 原圖C：Robot Crazy（開心活動的機器人）

詳細說明與解題步驟

一、將片名、內容與影評一起核對
The Aliens的外星訪客不友善，影評說很可怕，是帶有驚嚇氣氛的科幻片。The Shy Boy寫Roxy暗戀好友Rosa，屬愛情故事。Robot Crazy寫未來城市中的機器人Zax行為古怪、鬧出麻煩，並以Laugh out loud與I laughed so much強調喜劇、歡笑。

二、比較原題四張海報
C的Robot Crazy片名與歡樂、活潑機器人形象，最符合文中的喜劇線索，因此選C。A把The Aliens畫成可愛、輕鬆的飛碟角色，未呼應不友善與驚嚇的主調。B雖片名正確，但嚴肅地抱著地球的形象不如C直接呈現喜劇感。D的片名是人類暗戀故事The Shy Boy，卻配機器人，與內容不符。

三、這是最佳配對，不是從單一圖示猜故事
原文沒有說The Aliens會以任何特定外形出現，也沒有說Robot Crazy不能有其他情節。本題依已提供的四幅海報比較，以片名及主要情緒共同判斷；不自行補上機器人拯救或毀滅地球的劇情。
